neighbours.label: the word interposed between a modal auxiliary and its main verb: an inverted subject ('will it take' 0.74, 'can such a demand' 0.39), an adverb ('should ... ever' 0.73, 'must soon' 0.43, 'should never' 0.40) or 'not' ('may not fly' 0.70); a modal followed directly by its verb (0.15) or no modal (0.01) is quiet, and inversion with 'did' is weak (0.31)

Nobody believed a word of it.
